comment: The three public SDKs the acceptance clients (js/, rust/, java/) are built against, each a ristik fork at its main commit. The Dockerfiles clone the repo, fetch exactly this commit and refuse a checkout whose HEAD differs. Base images are pinned by digest in the Dockerfiles (node: the digest of deploy/testnet/bridge/pins.json; rust and eclipse-temurin: resolved with docker buildx imagetools inspect on 2026-11-09).
